  "task": "# Iteration 1 — Create README.md (the human front door)

You are documenting Blue Marble, a single-file 3D exploration game. **Read these first, in order:**
1. `.cyrus/cylinder/project-facts.md` — verified constants, controls, test commands. AUTHORITATIVE; do not restate anything that contradicts it.
2. `.cyrus/cylinder/doc-conventions.md` — voice rules + self-check rubric. Follow it exactly.
3. `_docs/architecture/design-philosophy.md` — borrow the tone/soul for the opening section.
4. Skim `CLAUDE.md` and `_docs/PROJECT.md` for structure awareness (you will LINK to these, not copy them).

## Deliverable: `README.md` at repo root — the ONLY file you may create or modify this iteration.

Write it with these sections (order can flex slightly, all must be present):

1. **What it is** — exploration game: tiny character on a miniature procedural planet, discovering places, taking photos. Objects are destinations, not obstacles. Truly single HTML file (~2700 LOC + base64-inlined GLB character, ~750 KB), Three.js r128 from CDN, no build system. 2–4 short paragraphs; link `_docs/architecture/design-philosophy.md` for depth.
2. **Design philosophy (why it exists this way)** — the single-file constraint (works over `file://`, GLB inlined in an inert `<script type="text/plain">` block, no fetch), procedural world, walk-up-to-anything collision philosophy. Summarize in a few sentences each + link to `_docs/`.
3. **Install / run** — honest: there is no install. Open `index.html` in a browser; works over `file://`. Only setup is `cd _tests && npm install` for the test suite (installs simplex-noise, puppeteer, cannon-es).
4. **Usage** — two subsections:
   - *Playing*: full control list from `project-facts.md` (W/S, A/D strafe, ←/→ turn, Shift run, mouse look, scroll zoom, Space jump, 1/2/3 camera modes, P photo, O selfie, E/T/Y/N/B emotes, M character, C color, F3 debug panel). Mention the F3 debug panel's `MC → meshface` health metric (< 0.05 good, > 0.1 broken).
   - *Testing / dev workflow*: table or list of the real commands — `node fulltest.mjs` (gatekeeper: 8-route walk test; per-route pass: world gap < 0.05, forward jitter < 2°/frame, tilt < 1°), `node walktest.mjs` (600-frame trajectory + per-frame metrics), `node test.mjs` (quick math check, <1s), `node collision_test.mjs`, `node visualtest.cjs` (headless screenshots → `_tests/screenshots/`), `node glbtest.cjs` (GLB load + animation). Include the `window._game` test hook (headless tests drive the character through it) and the character-swap workflow: `node _tests/splice_glb_inline.cjs path/to/new.glb` (new model needs clips named Idle/Walking/Running/Jump).
5. **Configuration** — key constants table: `PR=50` (planet radius), `CH=1.8` (character height, GLB scaled to it), `WORLD_SCALE=2.5` (placed objects vs character), `MAX_WALK=0.6`, `MAX_RUN=1.2`, detail level 6 (~40k tris; detail 7 drops FPS to ~20). **Re-grep `index.html` to confirm each value before writing it** — if source disagrees with `project-facts.md`, use the source value and note the discrepancy in your final report.
6. **Contributing** — the absolute rules, phrased as rules a newcomer must not break: collision boundary = visible mesh surface via raycasting, NEVER bounding spheres/boxes (tree collision = trunk only; open spaces stay open); NEVER camera smoothing/lerp; keep `groundHeight()` continuous; only the grounding system writes `character.position/.quaternion/.scale`; single-file rule (don't split `index.html`, don't add sibling assets or fetch). Plus: any formula change in `index.html` must be mirrored in the `_tests/*.mjs` replicas, and `fulltest.mjs` is the gatekeeper that must pass after grounding changes. Link `CLAUDE.md` and `_docs/architecture/grounding.md`.
7. **Current state / known issues** — honest: core loop works (14 authored zones, photo system, minimap, HUD, 3 camera modes, jump + land on objects); collision currently uses a sphere experiment (cannon-es) and needs reverting to mesh raycast; ~20–30 FPS; some placed objects float; no audio.

## Hard constraints
- Text only — no screenshots, no badges pointing at nonexistent CI.
- Never mention `index.v1–v4.html`, `experiments/`, `characters/`, or scratch `_tests/` scripts (`build_v*.cjs`, `nature_*`, `rock_*`, etc.) — they are untracked experiments.
- Do NOT edit `index.html`, `CLAUDE.md`, anything in `_docs/` or `_tests/`, or any other file. Comment-header work on `index.html` and `_tests/` scripts is a LATER iteration — out of scope now.
- All relative links in the README must resolve to real paths (`_docs/architecture/grounding.md`, `_docs/PROJECT.md`, `_docs/guides/testing.md`, etc. — verify each exists).

## Before finishing
- Run the 7-point self-check rubric in `.cyrus/cylinder/doc-conventions.md`. For this iteration that means: facts match source, README links resolve, no file other than `README.md` created/modified (`git status` should show exactly one new file), nothing contradicts the invariants.
- Run `node _tests/test.mjs` from `_tests/` as a cheap sanity check (should be trivially unaffected, but confirms the repo still works).
- Report any discrepancy you found between `project-facts.md` and actual source."
}

{"scope_ids": ["c2", "c3", "c4", "c6"], "new_items": [], "task": "# Iteration 2 — fix camera-mode error, add all header comments, verify nothing broke

Read `cylinder/project-facts.md` and `cylinder/doc-conventions.md` first — they are authoritative for every fact and voice rule below.

## 1. Fix the one factual error in README.md (closes c2)
Iter 1 wrote the README but reversed the camera-mode mapping. README line ~69 currently says `1/2/3 Camera modes (orbit / close / first person)`. Source of truth (`index.html` ~line 3147, re-verify with Grep) is **1 = first person, 2 = close behind, 3 = orbit**. Swap the parenthetical to match. This is NEW relative to iter 1: iter 1 wrote the table from a grep pass but got this one mapping backwards; this iteration re-verifies against the key-handler code specifically, not the on-screen hint text.
While there, also remove the meta-commentary line ~127 ('All values above were re-verified...') — it reads as agent process notes, not human documentation (assessor flagged it as a nit).
Do NOT otherwise rewrite the README.

## 2. Section-level block comments in index.html (c3) — comment-ONLY changes
Add a short block comment (5–15 lines each, `//`-style or `/* */`) at the top of each of these systems. Each comment must explain **WHY the design is what it is and what simpler alternative failed** — that context lives in `CLAUDE.md` ('How the Grounding System Works') and `_docs/architecture/grounding.md`; read them before writing:
- `groundHeight(...)` — analytical noise used for BOTH mesh displacement and movement stepping; must stay continuous (the ocean-boundary step function was the worst historical offender; smoothstep fixed it).
- `moveOnSurface(...)` + `updateChar()` — the analytical+raycast hybrid: pure analytical had up to 18% character-height gap on slopes; pure raycast was too slow and jittered at face edges. One ray per frame from PR+10 toward planet center is the ground truth.
- `getFrame()` / `_lastFwRef` — persistent forward reference projected into the tangent plane each frame; using face normals caused the spiral bug, world-Y-with-threshold caused pole flicker. This looks like a bug-waiting-to-be-simplified without the comment.
- GLB inline loader (right after `createCharacter()`) — why base64-in-inert-script (no fetch → works over `file://`, single-file rule), flat-shading forcing, the `character.userData.glb` contract with `animChar`, and the procedural fallback.
- Zone placement section — authored zones + global fill; link to `_docs/architecture/zones.md`.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: `git diff index.html` must show ONLY added comment lines — zero changes to executable code, and the base64 GLB `<script type="text/plain" id="character-glb-b64">` block untouched. Use the CLAUDE.md code map line ranges as starting points but Grep to locate the actual current positions (ranges drift).

## 3. Header comments in the seven canonical _tests scripts (c4)
Add a header comment to each of exactly these files (and NO others — do not touch `build_v*.cjs`, `nature_*`, `rock_*`, or any scratch script):
- `_tests/test.mjs` — quick math accuracy check, `node test.mjs`, <1s.
- `_tests/fulltest.mjs` — THE gatekeeper: 8-route walk test against actual mesh; pass criteria per route: world gap < 0.05, forward jitter < 2°/frame, tilt < 1°. Run after any grounding change.
- `_tests/walktest.mjs` — 600-frame trajectory recording with per-frame metrics.
- `_tests/collision_test.mjs` — collision verification.
- `_tests/visualtest.cjs` — headless-browser screenshots → `_tests/screenshots/`.
- `_tests/glbtest.cjs` — verifies inlined-GLB load + animation switching end-to-end.
- `_tests/splice_glb_inline.cjs` — helper: `node splice_glb_inline.cjs path/to/new.glb` re-encodes and rewrites the inlined character block in index.html. NOTE: git status shows this file has uncommitted modifications — read it first and add the header without disturbing whatever the in-progress change is.
Each header: purpose, how to run from `_tests/`, pass criteria / expected output. Read each file before writing its header so the description matches what the script actually does (don't just paste the CLAUDE.md summary if the script diverged).

## 4. Verification (c6)
- `cd _tests && node test.mjs` — must pass.
- `git diff index.html` — confirm comment-only (inspect the diff, don't assume).
- Launch index.html headless (puppeteer is already installed in `_tests/`; a quick one-off page-load-and-check-console script is fine, or reuse `visualtest.cjs`) and confirm zero console errors.
- `git status` — confirm no new files beyond README.md (already created in iter 1) and no `_docs/`, `index.v*.html`, or experiment files touched.

## Self-check before finishing
Run the 7-point rubric in `cylinder/doc-conventions.md` against the final state (this feeds c7, which the assessor will grade)."}
